mentions.name: Tresor AI
mentions.description: This is a confidential AI workspace for professionals that includes LLMs, documents, web search, and integrations. It uses end-to-end encryption plus hardware-sealed AI processing so user data is never visible externally, even to Tresor itself.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm currently working on Tresor AI (https://trytresor.com) - Al confidential AI workspace for professionals (including LLMs, documents, web search, integrations, etc). We use end to end encryption plus hardware sealed AI processing, so your data is never visible externally, even Tresor can't see it.
